product.name: Intelligent Terminal
product.tagline: AI-native Windows Terminal — your agents live here.
product.description: Intelligent Terminal is an experimental fork of Windows Terminal with native AI agent integration. Work alongside GitHub Copilot, Claude, Codex, Gemini, or any ACP-compatible agent CLI — all inside the terminal you already use.

features.name: Agent Pane
features.description: A context-aware, docked pane with your agent CLI of choice. The pane has context on your shell output across all your shells.

features.name: Error Detection & Autofix
features.description: When a command fails, an indicator appears in the agent status bar. The agent can explain what happened and suggest or run a fix automatically.

features.name: Command Palette Agent
features.description: Type ? followed by your prompt in the Command Palette to kick off an agent task. Intelligent Terminal injects context from the active pane.

features.name: Agent Management
features.description: View all active agents, their status, and past sessions. Pick up a workflow where you left off or check on a long-running task.

features.name: Agent Status Bar
features.description: A persistent, minimal control surface at the bottom of every window so you are never more than one click away from your agents.

features.name: wtcli Automation
features.description: A tmux-style CLI (wtcli / wta) that lets agents and scripts control Terminal windows, tabs, and panes over a COM protocol — no GUI required.

supportedAgents.name: GitHub Copilot
supportedAgents.description: Default agent. Set up automatically on first launch.

supportedAgents.name: Claude Code
supportedAgents.description: Anthropic's Claude via an ACP wrapper. Bring your own subscription.

supportedAgents.name: OpenAI Codex
supportedAgents.description: OpenAI Codex CLI via an ACP wrapper. Bring your own subscription.

supportedAgents.name: Gemini CLI
supportedAgents.description: Google Gemini CLI. Speaks ACP natively — no wrapper needed.

supportedAgents.name: Any ACP-compatible agent
supportedAgents.description: Any agent CLI that implements the Agent Client Protocol (ACP) works out of the box.

shortcuts.action: Open agent pane with error context
Open Command Palette in prompt mode

systemRequirements.os: Windows 10 2004 (build 19041) or later, including all of Windows 11
